name: 請求時期の説明とカード入力を持つ支払い方法の追加欄
prompt:
Create a faithful Japanese-localized “add payment method” form from the supplied references. Use the original crop as the primary authority for structure, proportions, field geometry, and button placement; use the Japanese preview for exact wording, placeholders, and green selection styling. Render only this complete form on a clean white canvas at roughly 559×547 proportions (about 1.02:1), without broad empty margins, browser chrome, or Mobbin branding.

From top to bottom, include: the left-aligned heading 「新しく追加」; a pale-gray bordered notice box with exactly these three lines: 「現時点で、この支払い方法への請求はありません。」, 「保存した方法は今後の請求に使う」, 「初期の支払い方法になります。」; a horizontal pair of equal payment choice cards, 「カード」 selected with a thin green outline and green icon/text, and 「米国の銀行口座」 unselected in gray; a full-width 「カード番号」 field containing only the supplied reference placeholder 「1234 1234 1234 1234」 with a small green 「カード」 indicator aligned right; then two equal side-by-side fields, 「有効期限」 with placeholder 「月 / 年」 and 「確認番号」 with placeholder 「3桁の番号」; and a full-width green bottom action button labeled exactly 「支払い方法を追加」.

Use light neutral input borders, modest corner radii, consistent padding, clear Japanese sans-serif type, and compact spacing that fills the form naturally. Treat the number as a sample placeholder only and do not show an actual card number or security code. Do not add extra text, logos, fields, or controls.

SHA-256 matches manifest/catalog; metadata has prompt/references; HTML includes it and canonical image was opened.
